goal: debug and fix undetected non-standard whitespace
change: Expand whitespace matcher to include U+200B ZERO WIDTH SPACE and add CLI/library regression tests
result: improved: zero-width space now detected and covered

goal: debug and fix undetected BOM-style invisible whitespace
change: Expand whitespace matcher to include U+FEFF ZERO WIDTH NO-BREAK SPACE and add CLI/library regression tests
result: improved: BOM-prefixed UTF-8 text is now detected and covered

goal: debug and fix undetected word joiner characters
change: Expand the matcher to include U+2060 WORD JOINER and add CLI/library regression tests
result: improved: word joiner is now detected and covered

change: Sort directory names and file names during recursive processing and add a regression test for stable traversal order
result: improved: recursive processing order is now deterministic and covered

change: Catch generic stdin processing errors, suppress detach cleanup failures, and add a regression test for runtime error reporting
result: improved: stdin processing now reports runtime failures instead of raising

goal: debug missing Unicode alias for NEXT LINE
change: Add a fallback alias for U+0085 NEXT LINE and cover it with a regression test
result: improved: U+0085 is now labeled consistently instead of UNNAMED

change: Teach process_stdin to accept text-only stdin objects without a .buffer and add a regression test for StringIO input
result: improved: process_stdin now works with text-only stdin streams instead of raising AttributeError

change: Catch directory traversal errors in process_directory and add a regression test for clean error reporting
result: improved: recursive walk failures now return False with a diagnostic instead of raising

change: Pass an onerror handler into os.walk so subtree scan failures mark the run unsuccessful and emit a diagnostic, and add a regression test
result: improved: partial recursive walk failures are now reported instead of silently succeeding

goal: debug recursive walk error path precision
change: Use the failing subtree path from walk errors when available and add a regression test for the reported filename
result: improved: recursive walk diagnostics now identify the blocked subtree instead of only the top-level directory
